implementation_boundary: passive domain contracts, deterministic candidate primitives, offline baseline analyzer and diagnostics; not wired into ResearchLoop, Acceptance, Closure, Planner, or Report

canonical_claim.normalization: V2.0 collapses whitespace for display/key primitives and preserves original text and qualifier fields. It does not claim semantic canonicalization.
canonical_claim.identity: claim_id is a database entity identifier; exact_proposition_key is a provisional lexical key, not semantic identity.

claim_evidence_link.integrity: run/question/dimension and source/source_owner_key are validated; owner identity is copied from canonical Source row, never inferred from role.

claim_relation.v2_0_behavior: Only exact or explicitly structured deterministic candidate matching; ambiguous text is UNKNOWN. Full semantic equivalence deferred to V2.1.

semantics.unsupported: no accepted Evidence supporting this Claim
semantics.supported: one or more accepted supporting Evidence links but verification contract is not met
semantics.verified: a versioned explicit Claim-level verification contract is satisfied
semantics.conflicted: accepted Evidence has an unresolved direct semantic contradiction
semantics.unknown: inputs/state do not permit a reliable verdict

verification_state.v2_0: contract only; no verdicts are produced or persisted

source_identity.owner_rule: multiple URLs/webpages may map to one owner; source type/role does not establish independence

known_v1_limits: one Evidence row points to at most one Claim
persistence.compatibility: No historical backfill; old Evidence without claim_id remains valid and maps to UNKNOWN/NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE.

phase_map.input: two CanonicalClaim records including original text, structured proposition and qualifiers
phase_map.output: SAME | RELATED | CONTRADICTS | UNKNOWN plus rationale/confidence

phase_map.scope: Independent Corroboration, per-Claim verification, contradiction detection
Planner/Retrieval Variance Reduction only if data justifies
Report upgrade, cross-family qualification, release hardening

v2_0_tests: tests/unit/test_claim_architecture_v2_0.py plus existing Evidence Graph and claim-verification suites
